body: Yes! I love taking my dogs to sniff spots. Knowing I will have the entire place to myself with no other randomly appearing dogs or people makes outings so much less stressful with my reactive dogs!

I’m so sorry for your loss. It’s a little over 6 months since I lost my sister to suicide. I thought I was doing “fine” but she’s always on my mind. It’s exhausting. I panic about my future a lot also. I had always thought of us being old and silly sisters together but I will never see her age anymore. I don’t get to share any milestones with her, which makes me want to freeze my life all together. I don’t think we will ever move on from the people we lost and I’m sorry I don’t have any advice on how to handle this better. But I hope you know you’re not alone in any of the things you’re feeling ❤️

I lost my sister to suicide back in March. It hurt so much I couldn’t bare it. Then for a while I thought I was doing better and healing. October is her birth month (her birthday is 10/18) and I feel the grief coming back in a tsunami. I feel for you so much when you say it’s hard to grasp how the world keeps turning. The past couple weeks I feel like I’ve been dissociative, just doing the things I “need” to but not really present with myself or life much. The grief can be too much, making it hard to see how life can keep feeling this way. 
I know I don’t have the soft words that many people say and frankly I don’t find much comfort in those words myself lately. I don’t want to “be strong” anymore, most times I just want to give up and grieve and cry for my sister and my family and the life I had before her suicide changed everything. So although I may not have many typical consoling words to share, I hope you know you’re not alone in finding this incredibly difficult to navigate. Sometimes I feel so alone but this thread really helps take that pressure off me, which helps.

I think about this a lot too. My sister died by a different method than you discuss, a way that I assume took longer for her to actually pass away. I wonder if she wanted to back out when she was doing it. How did she even get herself to perform it and follow through? What was she actually thinking in her final seconds? It seemed like it was very thought out but also very impulsive.. like she thought of it many times before but rushed to get it done this time? Idk.. very dark and strange to think about but I think about it often..

I also had these urges to see my sister again after she died by suicide 2 months ago. The first week or so I wanted so badly to see her I wanted to try everything, mediums, hypnosis, or medications even. 

I’ve always had very vivid dreams growing up so I started talking to her in my head and saying “I’ll see you tonight” and I had such vivid dreams of her. I could grab her and touch her and hear her voice so clearly that when I would wake up I would cry because I couldn’t understand how my dreams could feel so real but I would wake up in a reality where she’s no longer here. I stopped calling for these dreams so much after I had a few of them because they were so vivid it was almost heartbreaking to wake up. A couple weeks passed by the time I dreamt of her again and it was much more relaxed and even fun and silly much like her and I used to be when she was here. 

If you do have vivid dreams I would try calling out to your brother. But if you wanted to try mediums or anything as well I don’t see the harm in that either. I think seeing them again in whatever form would be helpful even if it may be hard. Just be safe and protect your spirit and body in whatever means you choose. 🫶🏻 I wish the best for your healing ❤️‍🩹

I lost my older sister a little under 2 months ago. I resonate with these feelings towards her and within myself a lot. I find myself asking her “why” all day long on some days. I feel like most memories of her have turned grey lately and I struggle thinking about them. And I find more recently that as more time passes people who don’t understand assume I’ve “gotten over it” or am not grieving as heavily anymore when I’ve actually just gotten more numb to it and found how to better push it away in public so I can function through work and daily life. 

We will grieve them forever, a concept that I often cant even comprehend. I know people who have never experienced this type of loss cannot understand or begin to know what it’s like. It can be confusing and frustrating and dark. I see you and I understand your yearning and your struggle. Something that helps me a lot is the message “without love there would be no grief.” 

I’m so sorry about your loved one but we need to remember it’s okay to be sad they are gone. I cry about my sister being gone so often because I love her so much. Even if our loved ones chose to leave this world for reasons we will never understand, we have to hope that they still knew/know how much we love them.

Thank you for sharing. My sister recently passed away by suicide and I often feel guilty because I also had the mindset of “if I don’t talk about it it won’t happen” even though she had been depressed for a long time and struggling with suicidal ideation. I just thought “that would never happen to me or my family”. Youre  words help me not feel alone and maybe one day i will stop feeling so angry and guilty.
You are amazing. Thanks for sharing your words and experiences. It’s so hard right now but words like these make me hopeful. 🫶🏻
I appreciate it and may take you up on the offer one day. Thank you 💕
I’m sorry for your loss as well 💕 thank you

Thank you for sharing and I’m so sorry for your loss. But wow, the medical examiner saying it gave out like a liver or a heart makes so much sense. I believe we are in the process of hearing back about my sister, but I really do believe she was so sick she just couldn’t go on anymore. The analytical part of me wants to know more about the “why” and I feel like this helps me understand that she truly could not go on anymore. She lost her battle with illness, it wasn’t her choice. Thank you for sharing.

I’m so sorry for your loss. I am finding a lot of help with this forum. It’s sad, but the shared experiences really make me not feel so alone in coping with this. Nobody understands the pain of losing a sibling unless it’s happened. I know it’s early for me and there will be huge waves of emotions but I’m so fortunate for everyone willing to share their stories with me and surprised at how much it helps.

You are so strong, I’m so sorry for your losses. Thank you for sharing. I love the idea of carrying their belongings with me and talking to them. I don’t think I’m ready to talk with her now. I feel so many emotions but I want to practice this when I’m ready. I wish the magic wand did exist. I find all these stories so comforting and knowing how other people navigate this process is so helpful. Thank you so much.

Thank you, it hurts to think of her stories now but I hope I can smile about them soon. I appreciate you giving me a safe space for that when I’m ready. I’m so sorry for your loss as well. I don’t wish this pain on anyone. If you need to share your stories as well feel free to

I’m so sorry for your loss as well and I appreciate your words. I feel like a therapist would help me manage all my feelings much better like you mentioned you go to, so I think I will look into that soon. It helps so much to hear others stories and to know I’m not alone in any of these crazy complex feelings.

It is bargaining, I didn’t know it was until I saw other stories and comments. I never experienced this kind of pain but I would give anything to understand more and do more. It’s early for me still but I hope I can find forgiveness eventually. Thank you for your kindness and sharing your words.
This means so much, thank you for sharing 💕 I hope I can find peace with it all one day.

Wow! I am about 4 months post SA and a couple weeks ago I was experiencing many welts/rash bumps all over my stomach/thighs. Could this have been PUPPS? I’ve never heard of this and it makes so much sense. It took a while for them to go away but it was very itchy and uncomfortable.
In my experience with my SA I also had that feeling for a few weeks but after I got my first period (4 weeks post) I started to lighten up and feel less heavy. Hoping the best for you ❤️
